layers.description: The layers this devcontainer serves (nx, agent, node, js, web, angular, design-system, navigation, firebase). The devcontainer is COMPOSED from their fragments (layers/<id>.ts `devcontainer`): the image (a neutral Debian base with Node as a feature unless a stack layer such as `node` brings its own), features, extensions, settings, mounts, env, run args, ports, OS packages and post-create pieces. Defaults to DETECTING them from the workspace; the sync passes them explicitly because it knows what it is about to ensure.

voice.description: Bridge the host's PulseAudio-protocol socket (WSLg, or native PulseAudio/PipeWire) into the container so the bespunky-voice plugin can reach the host speaker + mic. Adds .devcontainer/host-probe.sh (run as initializeCommand on every open: it points the gitignored .devcontainer/.host/pulse at this machine's socket folder, or leaves an empty dir when the host has no audio, so the container always starts), the bind mount of that path to /run/bespunky/host/pulse, and remoteEnv PULSE_SERVER + BESPUNKY_HOST_WSL_DISTRO. The espeak-ng TTS floor + pulseaudio-utils join the composed OS packages (built into the image as one cached layer), and the companion post-create.sh self-adapts on a socket actually arriving: it pre-installs the voice plugin only then. Opt-in only - never enabled by default.
